caption: A rendered Markdown table keeps its header and first column in view.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-freeze-panes']; p.settings.freezeNoteTables = true; p.settings.columns = 1; p.refresh(); await app.workspace.activeLeaf.setViewState({ type: 'markdown', state: { file: app.workspace.getActiveFile().path, mode: 'preview' } }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); p.refresh(); const box = [...document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bfp-note-table')].find(el => el.offsetParent); if (!box) throw new Error('No note table'); const head = box.querySelector('thead th'); const before = head.getBoundingClientRect(); box.scrollTop = 240; box.scrollLeft = 300; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const after = head.getBoundingClientRect(); if (box.scrollTop < 200 || box.scrollLeft < 100 || Math.abs(before.top-after.top) > 2 || Math.abs(before.left-after.left) > 2) throw new Error('Note panes did not stay in view ' + JSON.stringify({top:box.scrollTop,left:box.scrollLeft,before:[before.top,before.left],after:[after.top,after.left]})); return 'note table panes PASS'; })()

caption: Pro keeps a chosen visible property beside the file name.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['bases-freeze-panes']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('bases-freeze-panes-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); p.settings.columns = 1; p.settings.pinProperty = 'author'; p.refresh(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const box = [...document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-view[data-view-type=table]')].find(v=>v.offsetParent); box.scrollTop = 400; box.scrollLeft = 800; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const frozen = [...box.querySelectorAll('.bases-thead .bfp-frozen')]; if (frozen.length !== 2) throw new Error('Expected two pinned header cells, got '+frozen.length); return 'property pin PASS'; })()
